items.title: Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat
items.summary: The Democratic Party has won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, after Democrat Chuck Hubbard unseated Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.

items.title: SUV driver who assaulted pedestrian near Borella Kanatta released on bail
items.summary: The 37-year-old man arrested for allegedly assaulting a pedestrian following a road altercation near the Kanatta Roundabout in Borella has been released on bail by the Hulftsdorp Magistrate’s Court yesterday (22).

items.title: Trade Minister warns chili importers against creating artificial shortages to gain undue profits
items.summary: Trade Minister Wasantha Samarasinghe has urged chili importers to maintain proper quality standards and warned them against exploiting the market by creating artificial shortages to gain undue profits.
